FX-31/task/final-procedural-v1.text:
Task FX-31 — King Arthur sword arc flipbook. Priority P4. Depends on —. Purpose: the player sees that King Arthur's attack is boosted by his ability: a short golden arc at his sword. Trigger: CUE-014 hero ability of King Arthur (he attacks with a BOOST card); shown in the frame his attack card flips. Timing: 400 ms, 12 frames at 30 fps in a 4x4 grid (cells 12-15 stay empty), scaled with game speed. Keyframes: frame 0 (0 ms) a narrow 20 deg crescent at the blade tip, 30% length; frames 1-3 (33-100 ms) the crescent grows into a 120 deg arc along the swing from hilt to tip, width 10% of the radius; frames 4-6 (133-200 ms) the full 140 deg arc with a white core, golden body and dark keyline; frames 7-9 (233-300 ms) the tail melts from the hilt side toward the tip; frames 10-11 (333-400 ms) only a short 15 deg stroke at the tip remains and vanishes. Package contract.
- Write ONLY inside art/imagegen/fx-arc-codex/. Images that contain card scans, hero avatars, card backs, the board
  illustration or the environment concept go ONLY to scraped-data/derived/fx-arc-codex/. Nothing else on disk changes.
- No git commands at all (no add, commit, stash, reset, checkout, branch). Claude reviews and commits.
- Do not open, edit or build anything under unreal/. Do not start Unreal Editor, UBT or packaging.
- Do not edit art/imagegen/hud-icons-v3/ or its _tools/draw_icons.py. Copy the generator into your _tools/ unchanged
  (draw_icons_v3_snapshot.py) and extend it in a separate module.
- Before work, record sha256 of every input and of art/imagegen/hud-icons-v3/** in source-hashes-before.json;
  after work, prove in verification.json that they are unchanged.
- Save every generation unretouched in concepts/ and log it in generation-records.json with its exact prompt key.
- Final files use exact token hex values and are drawn by script (vector or procedural), not by image generation.
- Build comparison sheets in colour and in grayscale (Rec.709 luma), at master size and at working sizes.
- README.md in Russian: what was done, links to sheets, which variant you recommend and why, what failed, status
  "предложено". Report honestly: a limit you could not meet is written in verification.json, not hidden.
- Small decisions are yours; write them in README.md. Stop only on blockers (login, captcha, payment). Set: fx-arc. Effect language: flat shapes with a hard edge, 2-3 tones from fx.gold = turn.flash.yellow #F2C14E (body), card.glyph #FAF8F2 (core), mark.keyline #111317 (outer keyline), duration <= 600 ms, no smoke, no highlights, no glow gradients, no lens flares, no light emission, no camera shake. Shape first: short golden arc = Arthur sword. 1. Optional exploration: 2 image-generation concepts (A, B) on a flat #808080 background: "Original flat 2D game effect concept, a short sword swing arc, shown as a 4-step strip from left to right: a narrow crescent at the tip; a growing arc; the full arc with a white core; the tail melting into a short stroke. Hard-edged flat shapes, 3 flat tones: #F2C14E body, #FAF8F2 core, #111317 keyline. Style: flat printed board-game token language. Die-cut silhouette, constant-width hairline edge, flat print,
bold flat glyph. Three tones per element: body, edge, glyph; an outer dark keyline only where the element lies on the
board. No gradients, no highlights, no bevels, no embossing, no textures, no drop shadows, no glow, no lens effects,
no stone, no parchment, no metal, no bronze. No brush strokes, no ink splatter, no paint splash anywhere.
Shape is the first channel, colour is the third: every state must stay readable in grayscale. Forbidden: copying or imitating pixels, assets, splash art, logos, card text or fonts of any commercial digital
edition of a board game; brush-stroke banners and ink splatter; invented game data (card names, numbers, hero
names, HP, boards, spaces); text, letters or numbers baked into textures; red fills; any element on screen that
carries meaning only by colour." 2. Final: draw the flipbook procedurally by script: mask PNG with R = golden body, G = white core, B = outer keyline, A = max(R, G, B), straight alpha (decision ВР-FX03), plus a colour preview PNG; frame count 12, grid 4x4 (cells 12-15 fully transparent), cell 256 px; the hilt end of the arc at x = 25% of the cell, the tip sweeps to the right edge minus 10%; every edge >= 4 px at 256 px; colour bleed 4 px into transparent pixels; frame 0 = poster. 3. Sheets: every frame in colour (token tint on #061623 and on a board crop of our UE frame docs/game-design/evidence/DE-FOOTAGE/2026-10-05/I/marmoreal/combat-20261005-235827/joiner/s09-damage-number.jpg; sheets with that crop go only to scraped-data/derived/fx-arc-codex/) and in gray (Rec.709 luma); a timing strip with ms under each frame; a reduced-motion poster (frame 5). 4. verification.json: frame count, cell size, alpha range, maximum sprite count you assume (1; a system <= 64), tokens used. Deliverable: art/imagegen/fx-arc-codex/vector/T_FX_ArthurArc_4x4.png (1024x1024 RGBA mask), vector/T_FX_ArthurArc_4x4-preview.png, comparison/ sheets, README.md, verification.json, manifest-sha256.json, generation-records.json. Do: write the arc angles, radii and widths as numbers in README. Do not: no glow, sparkles, motion blur or particle trails, no red (King Arthur's cloak is red), no text or numbers, no frames or assets of any commercial game as input, no edits under unreal/ or art/imagegen/hud-icons-v3/. Acceptance: 12 frames plus 4 empty cells, 1024x1024; palette within dE76 <= 3 of the three tokens on the colour sheet; gray sheet present; outside_folder empty; at 48 px and 36 px (nearest x4) the arc stays one clean curve; no red.

FX-31/task/fix1-procedural-v3.text:
Task FX-31 fix1 - corrective run for the package art/imagegen/fx-arc-codex/ (CX-20).
First read docs/game-design/visual/06-tasks/prompts/FX-31.codex.md (the base task: package contract, keyframes,
tokens, mask channels, acceptance) and the package README.md, vector/frame-parameters.json, verification.json and
_tools/build_arc.py. Everything in the base task still applies unless this file says otherwise. The review accepted
the package except the points below; change only what they need. Keep: the circle centre (147.2, 164.0), the
centreline radii of every frame, the start/end angles and spans of every frame (20/50/85/120/140/140/140/100/65/32/15/15
deg), the 30 fps timing, frames 4-6 as one identical hold (accepted, ВР-VS2-FX31-03), the empty cells 12-15, the mask
formula R = gold, G = core, B = keyline, A = max(R,G,B) with binary values, the preview-only 4 px bleed (accepted,
ВР-VS2-FX31-04), the 4 px dark keyline outside the coloured band, the white core on the inner (concave) side of the
band, the three exact tokens.

Package contract (unchanged).
- Write ONLY inside art/imagegen/fx-arc-codex/ and scraped-data/derived/fx-arc-codex/. Nothing else on disk changes.
  No git commands at all. Do not open, edit or build anything under unreal/. No image generation.
- Do not edit art/imagegen/hud-icons-v3/ or other packages under art/imagegen/ (other sessions may write other
  packages during your run; they are not inputs and not yours - do not report them as your changes).
- Do not re-capture source-hashes-before.json; re-check the input and hud-icons-v3 hashes against it at the end.
- Before changing anything, write fix1-before.json in the package folder: sha256 of the current atlas, preview,
  posters, frame-parameters.json and of every board sheet in scraped-data/derived/fx-arc-codex/, and the current
  per-frame band / core / keyline widths. Keep concepts/procedural-v1-* and concepts/procedural-v2-* unchanged; save the
  new final atlas and preview also as concepts/procedural-v3-unretouched-T_FX_ArthurArc_4x4.png and
  concepts/procedural-v3-unretouched-T_FX_ArthurArc_4x4-preview.png and add a generation-records.json entry with key
  FX-31/task/fix1-procedural-v3 (selected: true; v2 becomes selected: false).

Fix 1 - a crescent, not a constant-width line (ВР-VS2-FX31-02). Today every frame is a constant-width stroke with round
caps (coloured band 7.2-8.85 px). On the 256 px sheet it reads as a thin even rainbow / spinner arc rather than a sword
swing, and at the in-game size the band is about 2 px. Change only the width profile of the coloured band (gold +
core); the keyline stays 4 px around the whole silhouette:
- the outer (convex) edge of the coloured band lies on the swing circle (radius = the frame's centreline radius plus
  half of today's band, so the outer silhouette stays where it is); the band grows inward from it;
- along the visible arc, parameter s = 0 at the trailing end (hilt side, the end that melts in frames 7-11) and s = 1
  at the leading end (tip side, x = 90 % of the cell in frames 3-11): the band is widest at s = 0.70-0.85, W_max =
  0.16 x the centreline radius (about 14 px in frames 3-11); at s = 0.5 it is about 0.10 x radius (the card value);
  it tapers smoothly to 4 px at the trailing end (blunt 4 px end, not a zero-width point); the leading end is blunt and
  rounded (cap radius = half the local band width). Monotone taper, no waves, no notches, hard edges;
- frame 0 (20 deg crescent) and frames 10-11 (15 deg stroke): the same shape scaled down - W_max 8 px in frame 0, 8 px
  in frame 10, 6 px in frame 11, both ends at least 4 px; frames 1-2 grow W_max smoothly from 8 px toward the frame-3
  value; frames 7-9 keep W_max while the trailing end moves (the visible part re-uses the profile of the shortened arc,
  so the trailing end always tapers);
- the white core (G) runs along the inner (concave) edge only where the local band is >= 10 px: core width = 0.4 x the
  local band width, never below 4 px where present, ends cut square inside the band (no core islands). Frames without
  a core today (0-3, 9-11) may get a core only where this rule allows it; write per frame whether a core exists;
- every edge stays >= 4 px at 256 px; nothing touches the cell edge (margin >= 4 px including bleed); still one shape
  per frame: no sparkles, no second stroke, no glow, no gradient, no red.
Write the profile (formula and numbers: W_max, s of the maximum, mid width, end widths, core rule) per frame in README
and vector/frame-parameters.json.

Fix 2 - board sheets on King Arthur at the in-game size (ВР-VS2-FX31-01, ВР-VS2-FX31-08). Today the board sheets in
scraped-data/derived/fx-arc-codex/ use the crop (720,480,976,736): that is Medusa (plate 14/16), not King Arthur, and
the 256 px cell is composited 1:1 on a 1080p crop, so the arc is about three times larger than it will be in the game.
Replace them:
- measure King Arthur's figure height H in px on docs/game-design/evidence/DE-FOOTAGE/2026-10-05/I/marmoreal/
  combat-20261005-235827/joiner/s09-damage-number.jpg: the red-cloaked figure on the space with the 17/18 plate,
  roughly x 1080-1130, y 635-705 of the 1920x1080 frame, base disc included, the raised sword included; write the bbox
  you measured and what it includes;
- in-game rule (ВР-VS2-FX31-01): the sprite is camera-facing (no vertical squash). Its pivot is the circle centre
  (147.2, 164.0) of the cell, placed on Arthur's sword hand (estimate it on the figure, write the px). The full-arc
  centreline radius 88.54 px of the cell is drawn as 0.5 x H on screen, so the cell on screen = 256 x 0.5 x H / 88.54
  (about 1.45 x H). Do the same in a 1280x720 copy of the frame (frame resized with bilinear filtering). Draw the effect
  at that size from the mask with bilinear filtering (resample the 256 px cell down, as the GPU would with mips; this is
  the only allowed downscale and only for this simulation sheet), the colour rebuilt from the channels as
  (R x #F2C14E + G x #FAF8F2 + B x #111317) / max(R+G+B, eps) with opacity A;
- sheets (all 12 frames, ms labels under the tiles, colour and Rec.709 grey): ingame-1080p-native and
  ingame-720p-native (tiles at native pixels, about 3 x the cell width each, Arthur and his plate in view) plus the same
  tiles x4 nearest; board sheets only in scraped-data/derived/fx-arc-codex/, the same layout on #061623 (no board) in
  art/imagegen/fx-arc-codex/comparison/. Delete the old Medusa-centred 1:1 board sheets from scraped-data (or replace
  them with master-scale sheets centred on Arthur and labelled «master scale, not in-game»);
- record in verification.json (fix1.ingame): figure bbox and H, pivot px, sprite cell px at 1080p and 720p, and at
  720p for frames 0, 3, 5, 8, 10: the coloured band thickness (R|G, coverage >= 0.5) at its widest point and at s = 0.5,
  and the full silhouette thickness with the keyline. The card wants the arc >= 2 px at 720p: expected band >= 2 px at
  its widest point in frames 3-8 and full silhouette >= 3 px there.
- 48 px and 36 px nearest x4 sheets (navy and board) stay, rebuilt from the new atlas; record per frame and size the
  component counts of the silhouette, of R|G, of R and of G. Required: silhouette and R|G one 8-connected component in
  every frame 0-11 at 256, 48 and 36 px. R and G counts are recorded honestly, not required.

Fix 3 - verification.json in the 07 section 1.2 format (ВР-VS2-FX31-07). Keep all current fields and add the
standard keys: source_unchanged (true/false + counts), exports (every PNG of vector/ and comparison/: size, mode,
margin_px, touches_edge), palette (off-token share of opaque final pixels, expected 0, plus the existing dE76 max),
gray (every final and sheet has its grey copy; luma of the three tokens), sizes (every deliverable path present),
outside_folder ([] for this run's own writes) and acceptance - each acceptance line of the card as
{passed, measured, expected, note}: 12 frames plus 4 empty cells; 1024x1024; palette dE76 <= 3; grey sheet present;
outside_folder empty; at 48 px and 36 px (nearest x4) the arc stays one clean curve; no red; plus fix1.crescent
(profile numbers measured on the atlas: widest band per frame and its s), fix1.ingame and the card readability line
"arc thickness >= 2 px at 720p on K1" as their own lines.

Fix 4 - the repository inventory out of the package (ВР-VS2-FX31-06). _tools/outside-metadata-before.json (about 6 MB,
names, sizes and mtimes of 42 449 repository files) must not be committed with the package. Move it to
scraped-data/derived/fx-arc-codex/audit/outside-metadata-before.json; if you take a new inventory for this run, write it
there too. In the package keep only a summary in verification.json (file count, sha256 of the inventory file, excluded
directories, observations). Note: other sessions edit files in the repository during your run; a changed file outside
the two package folders that your commands did not write is not your write - list it under
outside_metadata_observations with that note, do not fail on it, and keep outside_folder for this run's own writes.

After the fixes: rebuild the atlas, preview, per-frame files in vector/frames/, posters (frame 0 and reduced-motion
frame 5), all comparison sheets in both folders (navy and board, 256 / 48 / 36, colour / grey, timing strip) and the
new in-game sheets; re-run the build and the verification (build_arc.py and build_arc.py --verify). Update README
(Russian, status «предложено»): a short section «Исправления fix1» with the four fixes and before -> after numbers, the
numbers section rewritten for the crescent profile, the pivot and the in-game scale rule for FX-32, links to the new
sheets. Write manifest-sha256.json last. Do not change anything the review did not ask for.
